69feb17b89e5.t: The 12 Steps in the Big Book

93ce4eaf0be0.t: The Twelve Steps are printed on pages 59–60 of <0>Alcoholics Anonymous</0> (the Big Book), 4th Edition. Here is each Step exactly as the book states it, the pages where its instructions live, and a link that opens the free Big Book reader at that page — no account needed.

ec459c91acb2.t: <0>Open the Steps in the reader — page 59 →</0>

a576a3da288a.t: We admitted we were powerless over alcohol—that our lives had become unmanageable.

47a11301353c.t: Stated on page 59. The problem it names fills pages xxv–43: The Doctor's Opinion, Bill's Story, There Is a Solution, and More About Alcoholism.

ea8d6ee0ca19.t: <0>Read page 30 in the app →</0><1><2>Full Step 1 guide</2></1>

833310900cea.t: Came to believe that a Power greater than ourselves could restore us to sanity.

0455eb740ae8.t: Stated on page 59. Worked through We Agnostics, pages 44–57.

c49459279bf3.t: <0>Read page 44 in the app →</0><1><2>Full Step 2 guide</2></1>

9b8df43b7721.t: Made a decision to turn our will and our lives over to the care of God <0>as we understood Him</0>.

15e10195d448.t: Stated on page 59. Instructions on pages 60–63; the Third Step Prayer is on page 63.

7a7569a7cb33.t: <0>Read page 60 in the app →</0><1><2>Full Step 3 guide</2></1>

a14811373c5f.t: Made a searching and fearless moral inventory of ourselves.

cbb346c63c08.t: Stated on page 59. Inventory instructions on pages 64–71, with the resentment grid on page 65.

84f3fb66d71a.t: <0>Read page 64 in the app →</0><1><2>Full Step 4 guide</2></1>

f9460485ffec.t: Admitted to God, to ourselves, and to another human being the exact nature of our wrongs.

24173a8ec4c9.t: Stated on page 59. Instructions on pages 72–75 in Into Action.

58f9d83c408f.t: <0>Read page 72 in the app →</0><1><2>Full Step 5 guide</2></1>

aa4301668466.t: Were entirely ready to have God remove all these defects of character.

caee54dd590e.t: Stated on page 59. Taken on pages 75–76 in Into Action.

d0e866985e60.t: <0>Read page 75 in the app →</0><1><2>Full Step 6 guide</2></1>

9ed22e759254.t: Humbly asked Him to remove our shortcomings.

4d58356d54d1.t: Stated on page 59. The Seventh Step Prayer is on page 76.

b544980b0188.t: <0>Read page 76 in the app →</0><1><2>Full Step 7 guide</2></1>

858dd6a9cc4c.t: Made a list of all persons we had harmed, and became willing to make amends to them all.

c51fb12efef4.t: Stated on page 59. Instructions on pages 76–77.

8f78235d1f51.t: <0>Read page 76 in the app →</0><1><2>Full Step 8 guide</2></1>

f4a45e55c0d8.t: Made direct amends to such people wherever possible, except when to do so would injure them or others.

59dd880f10c8.t: Stated on page 59. Instructions on pages 76–83; the Promises follow on pages 83–84.

7dd77a4c81c4.t: <0>Read page 76 in the app →</0><1><2>Full Step 9 guide</2></1>

08ca1ccfe588.t: Continued to take personal inventory and when we were wrong promptly admitted it.

e22ec2ce21b0.t: Stated on page 59. Instructions on pages 84–85.

292cdc66af2c.t: <0>Read page 84 in the app →</0><1><2>Full Step 10 guide</2></1>

a2120c92d2d7.t: Sought through prayer and meditation to improve our conscious contact with God <0>as we understood Him</0>, praying only for knowledge of His will for us and the power to carry that out.

2a6b17ef0cfa.t: Stated on page 59. Instructions on pages 85–88, including the nightly review on page 86.

cfdfad29c884.t: <0>Read page 85 in the app →</0><1><2>Full Step 11 guide</2></1>

6dab4a9a5ee5.t: Having had a spiritual awakening as the result of these steps, we tried to carry this message to alcoholics, and to practice these principles in all our affairs.
